description: This file defines the 'JmsQueueListener' class, which extends 'AbstractJmsListener' and implements a listener for JMS Queue (point-to-point) messages within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles connection setup, message listening, and cleanup for JMS queues using JNDI lookups.

classes.name: JmsQueueListener
classes.description: A JMS Queue (P2P) message listener that manages connection lifecycle, message listening, and error handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: JmsQueueListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with JNDI parameters, delegator, and credentials.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JMS session and connection, handling exceptions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Sets up the JNDI context, looks up the connection factory and queue, creates connection and session, sets message listener, and starts listening to queue.
